artworks.title: Still Life
artworks.medium: color lithograph printed in yellow, blue and red
artworks.description: There is a tall vase with white flowers on a round table with a patterned tablecloth. The color scheme includes greens, yellows, blues, and reds. The vase is placed on the right side of the image and there is a small bowl near its base on the table. The background is filled with dense foliage patterns and shadows.

artworks.title: Old Market in Dresden with a Fair (Der Altmarkt in Dresden mit Jahrmarkt)
artworks.description: The image showcases bold, expressive lines and geometric shapes, especially in the building forms at the top. The scene is abstract with sharp angles and rounded arches resembling a cityscape. Subtle curves and arches within structures suggest windows and rooftops, while darker, merging strokes at the bottom imply figures in a bustling urban setting. The composition incorporates architectural elements in a dynamic and abstract way.

artworks.title: Men Splashing in the Reeds (Sich Spritzende Männer im Schilf)
artworks.description: The image shows sweeping and jagged lines converging to form two human-like figures in a highly stylized and abstract manner. The figures have bold and dark shapes with elongated limbs and exaggerated features. They appear to be engaging with each other against a backdrop of thick, uneven strokes that could be interpreted as a forest or flames. The abstraction blurs the boundaries of form and space, inviting viewers to ponder connections to the human body and nature.

artworks.title: Siesta
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract figures and forms. The image is dominated by dark, sweeping lines and large areas of black and grey shading. In the center, there is a form suggesting a reclining figure or object, with curved lines indicating contours and movement. Surrounding this form are additional abstract elements that could be interpreted as background shapes or details. Bold, gestural strokes contribute to a vibrant, energetic scene with a sense of spontaneity.

artworks.title: Nude Girl at her Toilette
artworks.description: The image is a sketch that depicts a woman from her mid-torso upwards. She is portrayed in a seated position with her body slightly turned to the right. The woman's face is shown in profile with her eyes closed, and she has simplified facial features and short, styled hair. In the drawing, she is nude and is holding a small round object in her right hand. Her left arm is raised over her head, resting on her forehead. Next to her, there is an abstract representation of a table with a carafe or decorative object on it. The background is plain without any additional detail, highlighting the woman and the objects around her.

artworks.title: Danish Farm with Manor House
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch-like scene viewed from a low perspective. A building, possibly a house, is in the center. Dense foliage obscures the horizon line, creating depth. There is a courtyard or garden area seen through an archway. Trees with large leaves frame the scene. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black, gray, and off-white. The outlines are bold and dark, with shaded patches and cross-hatching for textures.

artworks.title: Head of Prof. Dr. Graef
artworks.description: The image shows a stylized depiction of a person, focused on the face and shoulders. The person is facing forward, with a prominent head and neck visible. The facial features are abstract, with deep, bold lines defining the eyes, nose, and a curled mustache. The hair is represented with angular lines, and there is a suggestion of a beard or facial hair below the mouth. The clothing is suggested with broad, sweeping lines that create shapes around the shoulders. The person appears amidst an abstract background, predominantly filled with black and beige, with textured patterns giving the impression of depth and movement around the head and shoulders.

artworks.title: Taunus Firs
artworks.description: The image depicts a dense forest scene with tall, dark coniferous trees dominating the view. The brushstrokes are bold and expressive, using dark, thick lines to show the trees and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, with deep blacks against a light yellow background. The composition conveys movement and texture, with close-up details of branches and tree trunks, and distant tree tops creating a rhythmic pattern against the lighter backdrop.

artworks.title: Rocky Stream
artworks.description: The image shows a rugged landscape viewed from above, revealing a rocky gorge. There is no horizon visible. The focus is on the steep, jagged formations on both sides. The artist uses bold brushstrokes to depict movement and texture, creating a dynamic quality. The color scheme is monochromatic, with black ink against a cream background, emphasizing the depth and contours of the rocks. Trees are scattered throughout, and there are sinuous lines suggesting a river or stream below.

artworks.title: Standing Nude in a Room
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a standing figure in an abstract setting. The figure is depicted with angular and bold lines, appearing to lean forward while holding a drapery. The figure is simplified with minimal detailing, using black ink on a blank canvas to define shapes. The background consists of abstract patterns, possibly indicating an indoor setting. The composition emphasizes expressive linework and a sense of movement, reminiscent of early 20th-century expressionist styles.

artworks.title: Head Study (Kopfstudie)
artworks.description: The image shows intersecting lines and shapes creating an illusion of three overlapping faces in an abstract style. The central face displays angular lines, while the surrounding faces have additional facial elements like noses and eyes. The abstract design blends familiar human features with unconventional artistic expression.

artworks.title: Nude Woman
artworks.medium: color lithograph printed in pink, blue and green
artworks.description: The image depicts an abstract representation of a human figure, created through flowing lines and bold shapes. The color palette includes soft pink, green, and blue tones, with linear details adding depth and texture. The composition suggests a seated or kneeling person, set against abstract patterns resembling a room with walls and windows.

artworks.title: Schwabing
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a village in the distance. A church with a tall spire stands out among the village rooftops near the horizon. Small trees and foliage are visible. The scene is rendered in precise strokes, likely with a pen or fine brush, creating a detailed and clear composition in monochromatic black ink on a light background. In the foreground, a woman in a dress walks with a dog and a rake, and two more figures are seen walking towards the village. The sky above the village has thin, wavy clouds, and the fields have a horizontal texture.

artworks.title: Nymphenburg
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon, fields with textured grass, buildings, trees in the distance, and figures in the foreground. There is a pathway with a person in a dress and hat walking toward the viewer, other figures tending to sheep, and fine lines that create texture and detail in the scene. The artwork is done in black lines on a light background, creating a sense of simplicity and calmness.

artworks.title: Sendling
artworks.description: The image depicts a countryside scene with a path leading to a village in the distance. The composition shows the horizon high in the frame, with village buildings and a church steeple forming the skyline. The artwork is rendered in pen-and-ink, using precise lines and cross-hatching to define textures of grass, trees, and structures. The color palette is monochrome. A figure with two children and a dog walk on the path towards the village. The landscape consists of rolling fields, trees, and mountain outlines that add depth to the setting.

artworks.title: Bogenhausen
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a slightly elevated position facing a river. In the scene, there are trees and a church with a pointed steeple on the horizon. The etching uses fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and shading. The color scheme is monochrome with varying densities of black lines on an off-white background. Two figures with a dog are walking on a path near the river. The path curves, leading to a bridge in the middle ground. In the distance, there is more vegetation and small structures on the banks.

artworks.title: Giesing
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape viewed from above, showing a wide stretch of terrain leading to a village in the distance. The horizon is near the top third of the image, featuring a row of small houses and a prominent church tower in the center. The brushstroke technique is fine and detailed, capturing the texture of the fields and the cloud-filled sky with delicate lines. The color palette is monochromatic, depicting shades of brown. Figures walk along a winding path, with one person on the left wearing a traditional outfit with feathers. A small dog stands near a person on the right. In the distance, other people are seen further down the path and fields separated by a fence running parallel to the road. The background shows a lightly textured sky balancing the composition of the rural setting.

artworks.title: Thalkirchen
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral landscape from an elevated viewpoint, showing a range of mountains faintly outlined against the sky on the low horizon. A cluster of buildings, including a church with a prominent steeple, is visible on the horizon. The style is characterized by fine lines detailing the fields and trees in a monochromatic color palette of black and white. Figures engage in activities such as walking, carrying bundles, and tending animals in the foreground, adding life to the scene. In the distance, neatly divided fields, trees, and small buildings punctuate the rural vista.

artworks.title: Allegory of Poverty and Wealth
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around various pots and pans. The image shows characters engaged in conversation and culinary activities around a fire with a pot hanging above it. Cookware like teapots and serving dishes are illustrated along the lower center of the composition. The scene depicts a social or domestic scenario with intricate detail and flowing drapery, suggesting daily life or a gathering. The use of shading and line work creates depth and a sense of motion and interaction among the figures.

artworks.title: Grands Chasseurs--Le Cerf est prêt
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: Two men from the waist up are shown. They are both leaning forward slightly holding rifles. One man has a bald head and the other has short dark hair. Both men have prominent facial features with visible sideburns. They are dressed in uniforms featuring a high collar and horizontal stripes across the chest. One of the men holds a helmet under his arm. In the background, a group of people is gathered in front of a densely wooded area. To the right, a horse is rearing back near a tree. In front of the men is a lavishly decorated chair. The setting appears to be outdoors, possibly at a formal event or hunt.

artworks.title: Spring
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This image is an etching of a pastoral landscape. The scene shows an expansive view from an elevated position, with a distant town, spires, buildings, and water visible on the horizon. Sheep are grazing in a grassy area, tended by a shepherd playing a pipe under a tree to the right. A house with a balcony and figures can be seen on the left. Additional figures are on a path descending towards the town. The sky above is depicted with fine lines suggesting a clear day. The etching technique includes intricate line work for texture and depth. The monochrome palette features varying shades of black and white to enhance the rural and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Summer
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a pastoral landscape from an elevated view. A woman sits on a bundle of hay surrounded by farm animals. The background features a town nestled against hills with spires rising above it. The land slopes gently upwards to meet curved hills in the distance. The engraving has precise linework showcasing fine detailing and a monochrome palette emphasizing contrast. Texture and form are highlighted in the trees, buildings, and figures. Grass and leaves are intricately etched to show depth and texture.

artworks.title: Autumn
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a rural scene with a farmer sowing seeds in the foreground. A large tree is on the left with workers attending to it. In the background, there is a distant cityscape with spires and towers. The scene is depicted in shades of sepia and black with detailed cross-hatching and line work showcasing a sense of movement and detail in the countryside.

artworks.title: Winter
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 15 x 24.3 cm (5 7/8 x 9 9/16 in.) (cut to platemark)
artworks.description: The image shows a winter landscape from a bird's-eye view. The horizon with a town's spires and roofs is at the center. Delicate line work creates a detailed scene with figures engaging in winter activities near a frozen waterfront. The monochrome palette enhances the serene setting.
